{"command": "echo "Here is how you can kill VS Code using taskkill:

1. Open Command Prompt (cmd) or PowerShell.
2. To kill all running instances of VS Code, run:
   taskkill /IM code.exe /F
   (The /IM flag specifies the image name, /F forces termination.)

3. If you want to kill a specific instance, first find its PID:
   tasklist /FI "IMAGENAME eq code.exe"
   Then kill it with:
   taskkill /PID <PID> /F

4. To also terminate any child processes (e.g., extensions, terminals), add /T:
   taskkill /IM code.exe /F /T

5. In PowerShell, you can alternatively use:
   Stop-Process -Name code -Force

Make sure you have administrative privileges if you encounter permission errors.
""}
